summary: Fees $35 confirmed; added $31 off-peak. Added 50-amp, water yes (engine), sewer no, 32 family sites + 27 equestrian to 55 ft, vault toilets/water/dump, year-round, deep link, 14-night max. Note added for the drained lake.
flags: Phone missing: (419) 832-7662 (ODNR campground and park pages).
Pin fine: 148 m from the family sites' centre (41.13676,-83.62061), 40 m from the nearest.

Hookups conflict to read: inclusion evidence (Campendium) says the sites were 'converted 2024 to full RV hookups (electric/water/sewer)'. ReserveOhio types all of them 'Campsite Electric' with Water Hookup Yes and lists no sewer; ODNR says '50-amp electric sites', 'drinking water, and dump station'. Written water true / sewer false from the engine. ODNR doesn't itself say water at the site.

CONSTRUCTION: ODNR banner 'Dam Notching and Water Level Lowering Underway (August 2025): As part of the Rocky Ford Creek Restoration project, the lake at Van Buren State Park is not navigable. For your safety, do not enter the lake bed or the construction areas.' Campground stays on sale; no closure. Recorded in the note, not a status. The stored 'not waterfront' is unaffected.
ODNR's pages don't state showers; two sites give 'Distance to Shower > 150 Yards' in the engine, most give nothing, so showers left unset. Restroom Type is Vault everywhere.

Equestrian: 27 of the 59 RV-flagged sites (numbered within 05-32) are typed 'Campsite Equestrian Electric' in the same facility and numbered among the family sites; the pages don't say a non-horse camper may or may not book them, so only the 32 family sites are counted. No SPLIT: one facility, one loop, ODNR's bridle camp isn't described as a separate place.
